--- Declaration corpus for modules, aliases, callbacks, and nested ownership.
local platform = require("platform.runtime")
local utility = require('platform.utility')
require("platform.setup")

---@alias RequestId string
---@alias Phase "ready"|"running"|"complete"
---@alias Result string|number|nil
---@alias Callback fun(result: Result, error: string|nil): boolean
---@class Request
---@field id RequestId
---@field phase Phase
---@field payload table<string, string|number>
---@field callback Callback
---@class Options
---@field enabled boolean
---@field label "two  spaces // literal"
---@field values table<string, { name: string, count: integer }>

local M
local pending
local cache
M.options
M.options.enabled
M.options.label
M.client
M.client.requests
M.client.transport
M.client.transport.options

--- Returns a module-owned request, retaining its caller-supplied callback.
---@param identifier RequestId
---@param options Options
---@param callback Callback
---@return Request|nil
function M.create(identifier, options, callback)

--- Cancels a request and reports whether it was still active.
---@param request Request
---@param reason string
---@return boolean
function M.cancel(request, reason)

---@param request Request
---@param response_callback fun(response: Result, source: string): boolean
function M.client:dispatch(request, response_callback)

---@param request_identifier RequestId
---@param request_configuration Options
---@param request_completion_callback Callback
---@param request_transport_configuration table<string, string>
function M.client.transport.send(request_identifier, request_configuration, request_completion_callback, request_transport_configuration)

---@param request Request
---@return string, integer
local function describe(request)

---@vararg string
function M.log(level, ...)

--- This paragraph describes cancellation ownership across several requests and needs wrapping without changing the words or merging executable syntax into comments.
---
--- ```lua
--- local message = "a deliberately long example with -- markers and  two spaces that must remain intact"
--- ```
--- - Keep list entries separate.
--- - Preserve a second entry.
---@param request_identifier RequestId
---@param request_callback Callback
function M.documented(request_identifier, request_callback)

return M
